content:
**Fasnacht Sausage** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

A Helvetian delicacy, served during Fasnacht and has a 100% drop chance. It satisfies a large amount of hunger and health while temporarily increasing maximum HP with minimal Radiation.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Intestine (1) Spices (1) Spoiled Meat (2) Tick Blood (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Fasnacht Sausage | | Fasnacht Sausage (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after learning the Recipe.
- Some can be found near the Gleeful Butcher in Helvetia during the limited-time Fasnacht Day event.
- The Fasnacht Collectron station has a 10.8% chance to collect one each interval only when the Fasnacht Day event is enabled.

- Fasnacht sausage spoils uncharacteristically fast for a cooked meat item due to using a spoilage value normally assigned to raw meat items.
- Before Patch 25, the Fasnacht Collectron was not able to collect Fasnacht sausage or Fasnacht Donuts at any time due to a bug.
